html_title: StreetZim — Iimaphu ze-Kiwix ezisebenza ngaphandle kwe-intanethi
meta_description: Iimaphu ze-OpenStreetMap zasimahla, ezisebenza ngokupheleleyo ngaphandle kwe-intanethi, ezenzelwe isifundi se-Kiwix. Iithayile ze-vector, imifanekiso yesathelayithi, imo yomhlaba ye-3D nolwazi lwe-Wikipedia — zisebenza ngaphandle koqhagamshelo lwe-intanethi kwi-iOS, Android, Mac, Windows nakwi-Linux.
tagline: Iimaphu ze-OpenStreetMap ezisebenza ngokupheleleyo ngaphandle kwe-intanethi, ezenzelwe isifundi se-Kiwix. Iithayile ze-vector, imifanekiso yesathelayithi, imo yomhlaba ye-3D ne-Wikipedia — akufuneki qhagamshelo lwe-intanethi.
maps_intro: Khetha ummandla ngezantsi, ufake i-Kiwix, uze uvule ifayile ye-.zim. Iifayile zigcinwe kwi-Internet Archive — ukhuphelo ngalunye luhamba ne-torrent.
maps_intro_lang: Khetha ummandla ngezantsi uze uwukhuphele ngesiXhosa: iileyibhile zemaphu, ukukhangela ne-Wikipedia zingesiXhosa. Vula ifayile kwi-Kiwix, i-app yasimahla; iphepha lemaphu nganye libonisa indlela yokwenza oko, inyathelo ngenyathelo.
badge_overture_desc: iiwebhusayithi, iinombolo zefowuni nemidiya yoluntu evela kwi-Overture,
what_lead: I-StreetZim ipakisha idatha ye-OpenStreetMap — amazwe apheleleyo okanye amazwekazi — ibe yifayile enye ye-ZIM onokuyivula kwi-Kiwix. Isebenza ngokupheleleyo ngaphandle kwe-intanethi: akukho ziseva, akukho zicelo ze-API, kwaye i-intanethi ayifuneki emva kokukhuphela kokuqala.
what_p2: Ngokungafaniyo nee-app zeemaphu eziqhelekileyo ezisebenzisa iithayile ze-raster, i-StreetZim isebenzisa iithayile ze-vector ezizotywa kwisixhobo sakho nge-MapLibre GL JS. Isiphumo: ukuhambisa, ukusondeza nokujikelezisa imaphu kakuhle, kwanemo yomhlaba ye-3D — konke kuvela kwifayile enye ekwisixhobo sakho.
feat_vector_p: Iimaphu ezicacileyo nezigudileyo ukuya kutsho kwinqanaba lesitrato, ezisebenzisa isakhelo se-OpenMapTiles, ezizotywa ngqo yi-MapLibre.
feat_sat_p: Imifanekiso ye-Sentinel-2 engenamafu, eneenkcukacha zeemitha ezili-10, yawo wonke ummandla okwimaphu.
feat_terrain_p: Izithunzi zeenduli nokuphakama kwe-3D okuvela kwi-Copernicus GLO-30, imodeli yehlabathi lonke yokuphakama komhlaba.
feat_wiki_p: Cofa nasiphi na isixeko, intaba okanye indawo ebalulekileyo ukuze ubone inqaku layo le-Wikipedia neenkcukacha eziphambili.
feat_search_p: Khangela kwizigidi zamagama eendawo, izitrato, iipaki, iincopho zeentaba, izikhululo zeenqwelomoya neendawo ezinomdla.
feat_offline_p: Ifayile enye ye-.zim kuphela. Akukho ziakhawunti, akukho kuqokelelwa kwedatha, akukho nethiwekhi. Vula uze uqhubeke.
step1_p: Isifundi sasimahla se-iOS, Android, Mac, Windows ne-Linux. Sifumane ku-kiwix.org. Kwi-Windows nakwi-Linux, okwangoku vula iimaphu kwi-Kiwix PWA: i-Kiwix Desktop 2.5 izibonisa zingenanto, kwaye ukulungiswa koko kusafumaneka kuphela kwiinguqulelo zemihla ngemihla (nightly).
step2_p: Khetha ummandla ngasentla uze ukhuphele ifayile ye-.zim (okanye usebenzise i-torrent ukuze kukhawuleze).
step2_p_lang: Khetha ummandla ngasentla uze ucofe iqhosha lawo lokukhuphela: ufumana imaphu ngesiXhosa, iyifayile enye ye-.zim.
step3_p: Vula ifayile ye-.zim kwi-app ye-Kiwix. Kuphelele apho — imaphu isebenza ngokupheleleyo ngaphandle kwe-intanethi.
sources_intro: I-StreetZim yakhiwe ngokupheleleyo ngedatha evulelekileyo. I-ZIM yemaphu nganye iqulethe umxholo ovela kule mithombo:
src_map: Idatha yemaphu: © Abaxhasi be-OpenStreetMap, ifumaneka phantsi kwe-Open Database License (ODbL).
src_sat: Imifanekiso yesathelayithi: EOxCloudless https://cloudless.eox.at by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2021) — CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, ukusetyenziswa okungekho korhwebo kuphela.
src_elev: Ukuphakama komhlaba: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM — © DLR / Airbus, ibonelelwe phantsi kwenkqubo ye-COPERNICUS yi-European Union ne-ESA.
src_place: Ulwazi ngeendawo: Wikidata (CC0) ne-Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0).
oss_intro: I-StreetZim ixhomekeke kwii-app zokufunda ze-Kiwix ukuze kuvulwe iifayile ze-.zim. I-app nganye ingumthombo ovulelekileyo kwaye iphuhliswa kwi-GitHub:
footer: I-StreetZim yiprojekthi yomthombo ovulelekileyo. Ikhowudi ikwi-GitHub. Iimaphu zigcinwe kwi-Internet Archive.
card_preview_title: Jonga le maphu kwibhrawuza yakho, ithunyelwa isuka ku-archive.org
card_languages_title: Le maphu ineeleyibhile ne-Wikipedia ngolunye ulwimi, idityaniswa kwibhrawuza yakho
card_download_lang_title: Le maphu ineeleyibhile, ukukhangela ne-Wikipedia ngesiXhosa, iyifayile enye ye-.zim
card_original_title: Imaphu njengoko yakhiwe: amagama eendawo ngolwimi lwalapho; ujongano lomsebenzisi ne-Wikipedia ngesiNgesi
card_no_lang: Ayikafumaneki ngesiXhosa: le maphu inamagama eendawo ngolwimi lwalapho nojongano lomsebenzisi lwesiNgesi.
mp_meta_description: Imaphu yasimahla engafuni intanethi ye-{name}, ye-app ye-Kiwix: izitrato, iindawo, ukukhangela, iindlela ne-Wikipedia, ngesiXhosa. Isebenza ngaphandle kwe-intanethi kwi-Android, iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows nakwi-Linux.
mp_lead: Imaphu yasimahla ye-{name} esebenza ngaphandle koqhagamshelo lwe-intanethi, kwi-app ye-Kiwix.
mp_feat_nav: Iindlela zokuhamba ngeenyawo, ngebhayisekile nangemoto, ezibalwa kwisixhobo sakho.
mp_feat_overture: Iivenkile, iindawo zokutyela nezinye iindawo, kunye neewebhusayithi neenombolo zefowuni zazo.
mp_feat_wiki: Amanqaku e-Wikipedia ezixeko, iindawo ezibalulekileyo neendawo ezibukwayo.
mp_feat_photo: Khangela ngomfanekiso: thatha umfanekiso wophawu olubhaliweyo ukuze ufumane loo ndawo kwimaphu.
mp_dl_lang_note: Iileyibhile zemaphu, ukukhangela ne-Wikipedia ngesiXhosa, kwifayile enye ye-Kiwix.
mp_dl_original_note: Imaphu njengoko yakhiwe: amagama eendawo ngolwimi lwalapho; ujongano lomsebenzisi ne-Wikipedia ngesiNgesi.
mp_space_note: Phambi kokuba ukhuphele, qinisekisa ukuba isixhobo sakho sinendawo eyaneleyo. Iimaphu ezinkulu zikhutshelwa ngcono nge-Wi-Fi.
kg_android_1: Faka i-Kiwix evela kwi-Google Play. Isimahla.
kg_android_2: Khuphela imaphu engasentla. Ifowuni yakho iyigcina kwi-Downloads.
kg_android_3: Vula i-Kiwix, uye kwithala layo leencwadi uze wongeze ifayile oyikhuphileyo.
kg_ios_1: Faka i-Kiwix evela kwi-App Store. Isimahla.
kg_ios_2: Khuphela imaphu engasentla. I-Safari iyigcina kwi-app ye-Files, phantsi kwe-Downloads.
kg_ios_3: Vula i-Kiwix, uye kwithala layo leencwadi uze uvule ifayile ekwi-Downloads.
kg_mac_1: Faka i-Kiwix evela kwi-Mac App Store, uze uvule ngayo ifayile oyikhuphileyo.
kg_pc_1: Vula i-app yewebhu ye-Kiwix kwibhrawuza yakho uze ukhethe ifayile oyikhuphileyo. I-Kiwix Desktop 2.5 ibonisa ezi maphu zingenanto; ukulungiswa koko kusafumaneka kuphela kwiinguqulelo zemihla ngemihla (nightly).
kg_offline: Emva koko, imaphu isebenza ngaphandle koqhagamshelo lwe-intanethi.
tour_lead: Yonke into ekwezi vidiyo zimfutshane isebenza ngefayile enye ekwisixhobo. Zashicilelwa i-intanethi iqhawuliwe; kongezwe kamva kuphela imibhalo engezantsi namachaphaza abonisa apho isikrini sichukunyiswe khona.
tour_photo_p: Thatha umfanekiso wophawu lwesitrato, webhodi yevenkile okanye wedilesi ekwikhadi lesitshixo sehotele, ize imaphu ikhangele indawo ebhalwe kulo. Umbhalo ufundwa kwisixhobo sakho, ngoonobumba obhalwe ngabo: apha isi-Ukraine, isiGrike, isi-Arabhu, isiJapan, isiKorea, isiTshayina nesiNgesi, zibekwe ecaleni kwezinye.
tour_zoom_h: Ukusuka kwisixeko siphela ukuya kwisakhiwo esinye
tour_zoom_p: Iimaphu ze-vector zihlala zicacile kuwo onke amanqanaba okusondeza: suka kwi-Kyiv iphela uye kutsho kwisakhiwo esinye, uze uthambekise kwaye ujikelezise imaphu.
tour_drive_p: Indlela enqumla i-Kyiv, ebalwe kwifowuni yaza yalandelwa ijika ngejika. Ishicilelwe ngendawo yokulinganisa; inxalenye ephakathi yohambo idlalwa ngesantya esiphindwe kalishumi.
tour_terrain_p: Izithunzi zeenduli, imo yomhlaba ye-3D nemifanekiso yesathelayithi: iintaba ezingasentla kwe-Tehran.
tour_signs_p: Ukukhangela okufanayo ngohlobo ngalunye lombhalo, kwimaphu yesixeko apho uphawu lume khona.
tour_credits: Imifanekiso yeempawu, umfanekiso wesango nemifanekiso yesathelayithi ekwezi vidiyo nakule mifanekiso yesikrini yeyabanye: jonga ababulelwayo neelayisensi.
gallery_lead: Izikrini zokwenene zeemaphu, kwikhompyutha nakwifowuni. Khetha esinye ukuze usibone ngobukhulu obupheleleyo, uze utyhile ezinye.
langs_lead: Amagama eendawo, ukukhangela, imikhombandlela, amanqaku e-Wikipedia neemenyu zemaphu ngokwayo, ngolwimi olufundayo. Kuquka imibhalo ebhalwa ukusuka ekunene ukuya ekhohlo.
langs_step1_p: Lukhethe kuluhlu olungezantsi, okanye kwimenyu ephezulu kulo naliphi na iphepha.
langs_step2_p: Kwiphepha lolwimi lwakho, iqhosha eliphambili lemaphu nganye likhuphela imaphu ngolo lwimi, iyifayile enye ye-.zim. Eli phepha lesiNgesi linika imaphu nganye njengoko yakhiwe: amagama eendawo ngolwimi lwalapho, ujongano lomsebenzisi ne-Wikipedia ngesiNgesi.
langs_step2_p_lang: Kweli phepha, iqhosha eliphambili lemaphu nganye lithi “Khuphela ngesiXhosa”: imaphu enamagama eendawo, ukukhangela, i-Wikipedia neemenyu ngesiXhosa, iyifayile enye ye-.zim. Apho imaphu ingekalungi ngesiXhosa, ikhadi layo liyakutsho oko.
langs_step3_p: Iimaphu ezininzi zinokwenziwa nangeelwimi ezithethwa apho, njengesiCatalan se-Iberia okanye isiWelsh seBritani ne-Ireland. Iphepha elithi Iimaphu ngezinye iilwimi lidwelisa zonke iilwimi zemaphu nganye kwaye lidibanisa ifayile kwibhrawuza yakho.
langs_demo_note: Imaphu enye ye-Kyiv ngesi-Arabhu, isiHebhere, isiHindi, isiThai, isiJapan nesiTshayina. Igama elingenayo inguqulelo lihlala linjengoko libhalwa kuloo ndawo.
langs_grid_note: Inani libonisa ukuba zingaphi iimaphu esele zilungile ngolo lwimi namhlanje.
filter_none: Akukho maphu ihambelana noko. Zama ilizwe, ummandla okanye isixeko.
credits_intro: Iividiyo ezimfutshane nemifanekiso yesikrini zibonisa iimaphu njengoko zinjalo. Iimpawu ezikukhangelo ngomfanekiso, umfanekiso omnye wendawo ebalulekileyo nemifanekiso yesathelayithi ngumsebenzi wabanye, osetyenziswe phantsi kwezi layisensi. Imifanekiso yeempawu isikiwe.
